summary: STACK 2026 adalah kompetisi hackathon mahasiswa berskala nasional oleh GDGoC ITB dengan tema 'Agent of the Ocean: Vibing Beyond the Code'. Kompetisi ini terdiri dari babak Preliminary, Semifinal, dan Final Day untuk membangun prototipe solusi digital.

judging_criteria.name: Problem Clarity (Preliminary Phase)
judging_criteria.description: Specific users, a real need, and relevant supporting evidence.

judging_criteria.name: Fit to the Selected Case (Preliminary Phase)
judging_criteria.description: Clear connection between the problem, solution, and chosen case.

judging_criteria.name: Value and Originality (Preliminary Phase)
judging_criteria.description: Usefulness and distinction from existing alternatives.

judging_criteria.name: Feasibility (Preliminary Phase)
judging_criteria.description: Realistic scope, technology, and development plan.

judging_criteria.name: Abstract Clarity (Preliminary Phase)
judging_criteria.description: Coherent explanation and compliance with the required format.

judging_criteria.name: Problem Understanding (Semifinal Phase)
judging_criteria.description: Supporting evidence, user needs, and analysis of alternatives.

judging_criteria.name: Solution Design (Semifinal Phase)
judging_criteria.description: Core workflow, value, originality, and case alignment.

judging_criteria.name: Technical Feasibility (Semifinal Phase)
judging_criteria.description: Architecture, technology choices, data, and achievable scope.

judging_criteria.name: Execution and Validation (Semifinal Phase)
judging_criteria.description: Milestones, roles, testing, risks, and Final Day plan.

judging_criteria.name: Communication (Semifinal Phase)
judging_criteria.description: Clear and consistent proposal and video that accurately describe progress.

judging_criteria.name: Functionality and Reliability (Final Phase)
judging_criteria.description: The core flow works consistently in the main usage scenario.

judging_criteria.name: Problem Fit and Usefulness (Final Phase)
judging_criteria.description: The product addresses a demonstrated need within the chosen case.

judging_criteria.name: Technical Quality (Final Phase)
judging_criteria.description: Appropriate architecture, maintainability, data handling, and implementation choices.

judging_criteria.name: Usability and Accessibility (Final Phase)
judging_criteria.description: Understandable interactions, clear feedback, and consideration of intended users.

judging_criteria.name: Validation and Impact (Final Phase)
judging_criteria.description: Credible tests, honest limitations, and measurable or testable benefits.

judging_criteria.name: Final Day Execution (Final Phase)
judging_criteria.description: Substantive, traceable progress against the declared plan.

judging_criteria.name: Pitch and Technical Understanding (Final Phase)
judging_criteria.description: Clear demonstration and convincing team answers.

suggested_roles.name: Backend Developer
suggested_roles.reason: Dibutuhkan untuk memenuhi kriteria Technical Quality serta Functionality and Reliability dalam mengimplementasikan arsitektur sistem dan data.

suggested_roles.name: Frontend Developer
suggested_roles.reason: Dibutuhkan untuk membangun alur kerja prototipe inti yang fungsional dan reliabel sesuai kriteria Functionality and Reliability.

suggested_roles.name: UI/UX Designer
suggested_roles.reason: Dibutuhkan untuk memenuhi kriteria Usability and Accessibility dalam merancang interaksi yang jelas dan ramah pengguna.

suggested_roles.name: Product and Pitching
suggested_roles.reason: Dibutuhkan untuk menyampaikan presentasi dan validasi solusi sesuai kriteria Pitch and Technical Understanding serta Problem Fit and Usefulness.

warnings: Peserta yang lolos ke tahap semifinal diwajibkan membayar biaya registrasi per tim.
Babak Final Day direncanakan secara luring di Bandung, dan biaya akomodasi serta transportasi ditanggung oleh peserta.
Seluruh pengumpulan berkas, video, dan sesi pitching wajib menggunakan bahasa Inggris.
Setiap anggota tim wajib menyelesaikan persyaratan promosi (twibbon, poster, broadcast group chat, follow IG) secara individu.
